extension.description: Minecraft launcher, mod development and server management with Java, Modrinth and AI MCP tools.
setting.language: Extension language. By default, follows VS Code. English and Simplified Chinese can be selected independently.
setting.storageDirectory: Absolute path for metadata, caches and downloaded JDKs. Empty uses VS Code extension storage. Reload required.
setting.gameDirectory: Minecraft directory for shared versions, libraries and assets. Leave empty for the standard system Minecraft directory. Created when needed.
setting.projectDirectory: Parent directory for new mod projects. Empty prompts for a folder.
setting.javaPath: Default Java executable. Empty selects the required Java version automatically.
setting.microsoftClientId: Client ID of your Microsoft public-client app approved for Minecraft Services, with device code flow enabled. No client secret is used.
setting.minMemory: Default minimum JVM memory in MB. 0 uses the system-memory recommendation. Instance settings can override this value.
setting.maxMemory: Default maximum JVM memory in MB. 0 uses the system-memory recommendation. Instance settings can override this value.
setting.gc: Garbage collector. Default lets the selected JVM decide.
setting.jvmArgs: Additional JVM arguments; each array item is one argument.
setting.gameArgs: Additional Minecraft arguments; each array item is one argument.
setting.proxy: HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5 or SOCKS5h proxy URL. Empty falls back to VS Code http.proxy. Use Set Proxy Credentials to store credentials securely. Reload required.
setting.sources: Download sources by resource type: official, bmclapi or an HTTPS base URL. Custom bases preserve the original URL path. Authentication always uses the official endpoints. Reload required.
setting.downloadConcurrency: Maximum concurrent files per installation. Reload required.
setting.showSnapshots: Include snapshots and historical development versions in the version picker.
setting.autoUpdateManifest: Refresh the version manifest cache hourly while instances exist.
setting.autoOpenProject: Open a project automatically after creation or import.
setting.openProjectsInNewWindow: Open mod projects in a new VS Code window.
setting.debugPort: Java debugger attach port. Gradle runClient --debug-jvm uses 5005 by default.
welcome.projects:
Create a Fabric, Forge or NeoForge mod project.
[New Mod Project](command:minecraftWorkbench.createProject)
[Import Project](command:minecraftWorkbench.importProject)
welcome.content: Select an instance to manage its content.
welcome.downloads: Installation and download tasks appear here.
setting.windowWidth: Default game window width. Each instance can override this value.
setting.windowHeight: Default game window height. Each instance can override this value.
setting.fullscreen: Launch in fullscreen unless overridden by the instance.
setting.showOutputOnLaunch: Reveal the Output panel when launching a game.
setting.backupBeforeLaunch: Back up worlds before launching. Instance settings can override this preference.
setting.backupRetention: After an automatic backup, keep this many backups. Zero keeps all backups. Only managed snapshots are removed.
setting.checkConflictsBeforeLaunch: Check declared mod dependencies and known conflicts before launch. Requires access to Modrinth for recognized content.
setting.modrinthSort: Default order when opening the content browser.
setting.modrinthPageSize: Projects loaded per page in the content browser.
setting.compatibleContentOnly: Initially filter projects and versions to the active instance. The browser can show all versions at any time.
setting.contentReleaseChannel: Default version filter and channel used by content update checks.
setting.installOptionalDependencies: Initially select optional dependencies in the installation review. Required dependencies are always resolved.
setting.showProjectIcons: Show project icons from Modrinth in the content browser.
setting.downloadRetries: Retries per extension-managed download. Partial files are retained. Reload required.
setting.networkTimeout: Network connection/header timeout in milliseconds. Body timeout is twice this value. Reload required.
setting.showSnapshots.deprecated: Use the version type filter in the instance installation page.
setting.memoryPercentage: Percentage of system RAM used for the automatic maximum heap. Rounded down to 128 MB steps and capped at 8 GiB; explicit memory limits override this recommendation.
config.serverDirectory: Parent directory for isolated servers. Empty uses extension storage.
config.serverBindAddress: Default server bind address. Use 0.0.0.0 for LAN connections.
config.mcp.enabled: Register AI MCP tools. Disabling unregisters tools and closes the local endpoint.
config.sharedDownloadCache: Reuse verified downloads across instances. Client, server, libraries, assets, JDK and content files with checksums share a content-addressed cache.
config.downloadConnectionsPerFile: Parallel range connections per large file. Falls back to one connection when unsupported. All downloads share the global concurrency limit.
config.downloadChunkSize: Segment size in MiB for files of at least 16 MiB. Completed segments survive retries.
setting.instanceDirectory: Prism / MultiMC instances parent directory. Leave empty for the instances folder in the Minecraft directory. Can point to PrismLauncher/instances. Existing instances are imported separately.
setting.gameLanguage: Minecraft language: auto follows the extension language, preserve keeps the game setting, or use a code such as en_us / zh_cn. Auto preserves languages changed in-game.
setting.metadataConcurrency: Maximum parallel Modrinth metadata requests during conflict checks. Further requests stop after a network failure.
setting.terracotta.enabled: Enable the optional Terracotta Beta page. Off by default. Downloads and room operations also require separate acceptance of the Terracotta notices. Disabling disconnects rooms opened by this extension.
setting.terracotta.executable: Optional path to the unmodified official Terracotta executable or macOS app. Leave empty to use the downloaded component. macOS requires the official background-component installation.
setting.terracotta.publicNodes: Additional Terracotta public relay URLs. Empty uses the official component defaults. Changes apply to the next room connection.
